question.problem: Determine the equation of the line that passes through the points $(4,7)$ and $(5,17).$
question.worked_solution:
We will write the equation of the line in the slope-intercept form $y=mx+b.$ So, we need to work out the slope $m$ and the $y$-intercept $b.$

First, we calculate the slope $m$ using the given points:

$$
\begin{aligned}m & =\frac{{y}_{2}-{y}_{1}}{{x}_{2}-{x}_{1}} \\  & =\frac{17-7}{5-4} \\  & =\frac{10}{1} \\  & =10\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the slope $m=10$ into the slope-intercept formula $y=mx+b,$ we reach

$$
y=10x+b.
$$

We now need to find the $y$-intercept $b.$ We can find this by substituting the coordinates of a point on the line. Any point will do, so let's substitute $(4,7):$

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =10x+b \\ 7 & =10(4)+b \\ 7 & =40+b \\ 7-40 & =b \\ -33 & =b.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the equation of the line is $y=10x-33.$
